name: Urdi
source:
Urdi is one of the three Norns. Her main role among the three is to hold the fabric of reality together and reverse time back to the past if something were to happen that threatens to unravel the fabric of the universe.

She is the wisest of the Norns and is frequently occupied with the reparation of chronal anomalies.

[In game description]
